_comment: Provenance for passport_index_baseline.csv. This is NON-OFFICIAL aggregated reference data used ONLY to give every nationality x destination pair a DEFINED, honestly-labelled PROVISIONAL outcome. It is never presented as verified, never counted as released coverage, and is superseded by any official-source research record.
upstream_data_origin: passportindex.org (aggregated public information; not a government source)
honesty_rules: Imported rows carry source=reference_dataset and verification_status=provisional.
A provisional row is NEVER exported or displayed as verified and never releases an adapter or workflow on its own.
Official-source research (source=official_research, verification_status=verified) always takes precedence.
Dataset age (2025-01-12) predates the snapshot; rules may have changed. Every provisional row is subject to on-demand official research before any live action.
